message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with the masthead "TEMPO" in large red capital letters. Below it, the tagline reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the top, text reads "KADO SP3 UNTUK SANG IMAM" and "PRAHARA DI MEIKARTA".

The central image features two men rendered in a caricature style. The man on the left has a wide, rounded face, a slight smirk, and small dark spots on his chin. He wears a white shirt and holds a large pie chart. The chart has red, black, green, and yellow sections. The man on the right wears glasses, has a mustache, and is shown with his mouth open, literally biting into the edge of another pie chart. This second chart contains red, black, and green sections. Both men have their hands positioned on the circular edges of these charts.

Main text on the right reads "CERITA PARA PENGGERUS SUARA" above a smaller paragraph. In the bottom-right corner, small text identifies the figures as "Sudrajat dan Sudirman Said". A barcode and date "2-8 JULI 2018" appear at the bottom-left.
